items: 【2026 Android 15 Tablet + Gemini AI Tablet】The Tablet combines robust privacy safeguards with intuitive operation. Functions including app permission control and facial recognition effectively protect your personal information. Split-screen, widgets, and smart auto-fill greatly boost daily efficiency. Equipped with Gemini AI, this 11-inch tablet works as your round-the-clock intelligent assistant. From creating meeting notes and instant translation to organizing travel plans, the gaming tablet handles all tasks smoothly and intelligently

【Ample Memory】This 11-inch android tablet comes with a high-capacity memory setup, featuring 24GB(6GB+18GB Expandable) RAM and 256GB internal storage. The Android tablet with keyboard also supports extra TF card expansion up to 2TB, giving you plenty of space to save videos, files and content for on-the-go entertainment and daily use

【11" Immersive IPS Screen】This Android tablet is equipped with a responsive 11-inch IPS screen featuring 1280x800 resolution. The large, crisp display delivers immersive and vivid visuals, ideal for watching videos, gaming, reading e-books and various daily scenarios. With Widevine L1, this android tablet 11 inch ensures you can stream HD and full-HD videos smoothly across your favorite streaming platforms

【Octa-core + 8000mAh Battery】This tablet 11 inch is driven by the Unisoc T615 octa-core processor, offering outstanding fluidity for daily apps and seamless multitasking. With combination of A75 and A55 CPU architectures, it delivers stable, high-efficiency performance while effectively lowering power usage for longer-lasting operation. The tablet with keyboard bundle comes with a powerful 8000mAh large-capacity battery, offering stable and long-lasting power for daily work, travel, and prolonged streaming entertainment

【Stay Connected】The tablet with keyboard comes with a full set of practical accessories, allowing you to use it just like a laptop for work and daily tasks. The electronics tablets supports Bluetooth 5.0, along with 5G and 2.4G dual-band Wi-Fi, ensuring stable and high-speed connections. Whether you’re at home, in the office, or on a trip, you can always enjoy fast networking and smooth, reliable connectivity

【2-in-1 Tablet Bundle for Multiple Scenarios】The Suicoey tablet is personalized and user-friendly, so it's also easy to use for seniors Package Includes: 1 x 11-inch Tablet, 1 x Keyboard, 1 x Mouse, 1 x Stylus, 1 x Black Case, 1 x User Manual,1 x USB Charger, 1 x Type-C Cable (Tip: The tablets themselves are same light blue in color. The color difference is reflected in the tablet case)
